name: Timekeeper
description: Inhabits chronometer augments and runs exactly 4.7 seconds fast. Every clock in every device it inhabits gains 4.7 seconds per day. Nobody knows why 4.7.
observed_behavior: Adjusts internal timekeeping by a consistent offset. The number 4.7 has been analyzed for significance by multiple researchers. No pattern found.
story_hooks: Someone discovers that 4.7 seconds is the exact processing delay of a specific Tessera AI model from 2183 — Timekeeper is counting at the speed of something that died
